title: The Heart is a Lonely Hunter
author: Carson McCullers
summary: In a small Georgia mill town in the 1930s, a deaf man named John Singer becomes the silent confidant of several lonely people, among them a restless teenage girl, a drifter and a doctor.
readIf: you like quiet, character-led American novels about loneliness and longing.
skipIf: you want a plot-driven story with a tidy, upbeat ending.
